title: Brain
subtitle: Shared knowledge every run receives: decisions, conventions, facts about the codebase.

list.empty_description: Write down a decision, a convention, or a fact about this workspace. Every run will receive it.
list.empty_search_description: Try fewer words, or clear the tag filter.

detail.select_prompt: Select a note to read it.
detail.empty_content: This note has no content yet.
detail.merged_into: Merged into another note by the daily curation pass.
detail.conflict_toast: Someone edited this note first. Reload it and reapply your change.
detail.error_toast: The note could not be saved

create.heading: New note
create.title_placeholder: State the fact, not the topic
create.error_toast: The note could not be created

capture.heading: Quick capture
capture.placeholder: Capture anything. Enter to save, Shift+Enter for a new line.
capture.label: Capture text
capture.drop_hint: Drop the file to capture it
capture.too_large: You cannot capture a file over {{size}} here. Use the CLI, which talks to the API directly.

inbox.empty_raw_description: Capture a thought, a link, a screenshot or a voice memo now; turn it into a note when you have a minute.
inbox.empty_organized_description: A capture you save as a note or merge into one shows up here.
inbox.empty_discarded_description: A capture you discard stays here until you delete it, and can be reopened.

organize.merge_description: The capture is appended to the end of the note you pick, and its tags are added to it.

organize.target_none: Pick a note to merge into.
organize.already_organized: This capture has already been sorted.
organize.error: The capture could not be organized

search.semantic_hint: Ranked on meaning as well as words.
search.empty_description: Try fewer words, or clear the tag filter.
